# json-ld

JSON-LD 1.1 processor for PHP: expand, flatten, node API, RDF and N-Quads.

Install: `composer require rasuvaeff/json-ld`

Runtime deps: `ext-json`, `ext-mbstring`, `psr/http-client ^1.0`,
`psr/http-factory ^1.0`, `psr/http-message (^1.0 || ^2.0)`.

## Rules

- PHP 8.3+, `declare(strict_types=1)`, documents are PHP arrays (never stdClass).
- No implicit I/O: remote contexts load only through an injected
  `ContextLoaderInterface`; the default `InlineContextLoader` refuses URLs.
  `PsrContextLoader` takes a URL policy closure and a body size limit.
- Every `JsonLdException` message is the W3C error code (`invalid @id value`).
- Not implemented: compaction, framing, JSON-LD 1.0 processing mode.
- Compare RDF with `Dataset::equals()` (blank node renaming), not text.

## API

```php
use Rasuvaeff\JsonLd\ExpandOptions;
use Rasuvaeff\JsonLd\JsonLd;

$o = new ExpandOptions(base: 'https://example.com/', documentUrl: null, expandContext: null, loader: $loader);

JsonLd::expand(array|string $input, ?ExpandOptions $o = null): list<mixed>;
JsonLd::flatten(array|string $input, ?ExpandOptions $o = null): list<array>;   // sorted by @id, blank nodes _:b0...
JsonLd::document(array|string $input, ?ExpandOptions $o = null): Graph\Document;
JsonLd::toRdf(array|string $input, ?ExpandOptions $o = null, bool $produceGeneralizedRdf = false, ?string $rdfDirection = null): Rdf\Dataset;
JsonLd::fromRdf(Rdf\Dataset $d, bool $useNativeTypes = false, bool $useRdfType = false, ?string $rdfDirection = null): list<mixed>;
JsonLd::serializeNQuads(Rdf\Dataset $d): string;
JsonLd::parseNQuads(string $nquads): Rdf\Dataset;   // InvalidNQuadsException on bad syntax
```

A string input is inline JSON (`{`/`[`) or a URL given to the loader.

Loaders: `Loader\ContextLoaderInterface::load(string $reference): LoadedContext`
(`documentUrl`, `document`, `contextUrl`); `InlineContextLoader`;
`new PsrContextLoader($client, $requestFactory, urlPolicy: fn(string $u): bool => ..., maxBytes: 1_048_576)`.

Node API: `$doc = JsonLd::document(...)`; `$doc->defaultGraph()`, `$doc->graph(string $name)`,
`$graph->nodes()`, `->node(string $id)`, `->byType(string $iri)`;
`Node::id()`, `types()`, `hasType()`, `properties()`, `values($p)`, `value($p)`, `references($p)`, `reference($p)`, `toArray()`.

IRIs: `Iri::of('http://a/b')->resolve(Iri::of('../c'))`, `isAbsolute()`, `(string)`.

RDF: `Dataset::equals()`, `canonicalHash()`, `quads()`; `Quad(subject, predicate, object, graph)`;
terms `Rdf\Iri`, `Rdf\BlankNode`, `Rdf\Literal`.

Exceptions (all extend `Exception\JsonLdException`): `InvalidContextException`, `InvalidInputException`,
`ContextRecursionException`, `DocumentLoadingException`, `InvalidJsonException`, `InvalidNQuadsException`.
